visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a thin-strapped black tank top and a silver chain necklace, sits in a dimly lit indoor space. She holds a white cosmetic pad in her right hand and rubs it against a large, dark purple bruise on her right thigh. The lighting is soft and focused on her skin. (2) She looks directly into the camera with an expressive face, pointing her index finger toward the bruise on her leg to emphasize coverage. Large white Chinese characters appear over the frame. She transitions to giving a thumbs up with her right hand, smiling slightly, while the background remains a blurred domestic setting. (3) The scene shifts to close-ups of her face, showing her wearing matte makeup with pink eyeshadow and red lipstick. She holds a black round compact in her hand, displaying it to the camera. The background shows a white cabinet and a dark wall, lit by bright studio-style indoor lighting. (4) A macro shot features a silver metallic cushion foundation compact with the 'M·A·C' logo on top. Her hands, with white and grey marble-patterned nails, open the lid to reveal a mirror and a sponge saturated with liquid foundation. The light reflects off the shiny silver surface of the product. (5) She is seen applying the foundation to her face using a black circular puff. She dabs the puff onto her cheeks and nose, looking into a hand mirror. Her movements are precise as she demonstrates the product's texture. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her skin's smooth finish. (6) The woman holds up two different MAC skincare bottles—one pink and one cream-colored—against her face. She then dispenses a drop of the liquid onto the back of her hand and uses her finger to spread the iridescent product, demonstrating its consistency and glow under the bright indoor lights. (7) A vertical split-screen appears, labeled 'After' on the left and 'Before' on the right. She touches her cheek with the makeup puff on the 'After' side, showing a clear reduction in skin redness and imperfections compared to the original 'Before' side. The background is a plain, neutral wall. (8) She holds a purple metallic rectangular palette and uses a fluffy makeup brush to apply powder to her forehead and nose. She looks into the palette's mirror while applying the product. The room lighting is warm and domestic, with soft shadows appearing on the walls behind her. (9) The scene changes to an outdoor setting on a sunny day with bright natural daylight. She wears a grey tank top and a blue bag strap, standing on a sidewalk with a road and trees in the background. She touches her forehead and looks at the camera, showing her makeup's durability. (10) Back in the indoor studio setting, she holds the silver cushion compact again, gesturing with her hands while talking. She finishes the video with an 'OK' hand sign and a confident smile, with the blurred indoor background providing a professional lifestyle context.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track begins with a steady synth bassline and rhythmic percussion. A female voice with a friendly, energetic tone and moderate pitch introduces the video. There are no significant sound effects, and the audio environment sounds like a quiet, treated indoor studio. (2) As the speaker highlights the bruise on her leg, her vocal intensity increases slightly to show excitement. The music continues at a constant tempo, providing a bright and commercial atmosphere. No incidental noises or environmental hums are detected, suggesting high-quality post-production editing. (3) The female narrator’s speech rate remains steady and clear, exhibiting professional articulation. A subtle mechanical click sound effect is heard as she opens the makeup compact, synchronized with the visual transition. The BGM maintains a consistent volume level, layered clearly below the primary vocal track. (4) During the product close-up, the music’s melodic elements become more prominent while the voice explains the technical features of the foundation. The vocal prosody shows high variability, with rising intonations used to emphasize key selling points. The acoustic space feels dry and intimate. (5) In the final outdoor segment, the audio mix shifts slightly; a very faint urban background murmur is present, though the primary BGM and clear narration still dominate. The video concludes with the music fading out quickly after the speaker's final recommendation, ending on a positive and authoritative vocal note.
